tools.description: Direct link to the right account page for anything not doable in chat — billing, browser upload, report management. Hand the user the link and guide them.
tools.name: account_link

tools.description: Platform documentation and info — how it works, tiers, usage.

topic.description: Topic: platform, manual, connectors, or a docs section

tools.name: about

tools.description: AI help desk — which analysis fits your question, interpreting results, fixing errors. Multi-turn.
tools.name: agent_advisor

tools.description: Get your data in. Pass `data` as an array of row objects to create the dataset immediately and get a dataset_ref ready for create_analysis; omit it to get an upload link for a file only the user can reach. Add replace_ref (uuid://ID:KEY) with data to REFRESH an existing dataset in place — schedules and tools holding that reference read the new data on their next run.

data.description: Rows as an array of flat objects — creates the dataset in one call

replace_ref.description: uuid://ID:KEY of an existing dataset to overwrite in place with `data` (the push/refresh mode)

tools.name: datasets_upload

tools.description: List and search your uploaded datasets — fuzzy matching on name, description, and tags. Returns each dataset's uuid:// reference for use in create_analysis and run_analysis.

search.description: Search by name, description, or tags

tools.name: datasets_list

tools.description: Browse the analyses you can run — the ones you commissioned plus the platform Standard Library (prebuilt tools; each result tagged source:'own' or 'standard_library'). Plain-language match; no query lists everything, your own first. Nothing fits? Commission it with create_analysis.

query.description: Plain-language search over your library + the Standard Library; omit to list everything

tools.name: discover_tools

tools.description: Get an analysis's parameter schema — ALWAYS call before run_analysis.
tools.name: tools_schema

tools.description: Run an analysis on your data. Returns a shareable interactive report URL — validated statistics you can cite, re-run, and share.

taskList.description: Execution inputs. Call tools_schema first for the analysis-specific fields.

userContext.description: Business context: objective (what you want to learn, required) and company

tool_name.description: Name of the analysis to run

tools.name: run_analysis

tools.description: Commission a NEW analysis built for your question. tier is REQUIRED — the user picks. Easiest: fuzzy_request (plain language) + dataset_ref + tier. Snapshot = instant automated report (~2-10 min). JSON = a fast computed answer, numbers + method, re-runnable tool you own (~5 min). Brief = the computed answer on a one-page report — chart, numbers, method (~7 min). Deck = commissioned deep analysis, a durable re-runnable module you own (30-45 min). Failed builds are never billed.

fuzzy_request.description: Plain-language description of the analysis you want

notes.description: Optional context for the build — constraints, definitions, or preferences the analyst agents should honor

tier.description: snapshot = instant report (~2-10 min); json = fast computed answer (~5 min, default); brief = one-page report of the answer (~7 min); deck = commissioned re-runnable module (30-45 min)

tools.name: create_analysis

tools.description: Modify an EXISTING analysis into a new version — reword the question, swap the method, or add a variable. Pass tool_name + changes (plain language). Rebuilds on the analysis's own dataset by default; the original stays put. Returns pipeline tracking — follow with build_status.

changes.description: What to change, in plain language, e.g. 'also break it down by region' or 'use a random forest instead'

dataset_ref.description: Optional — rebuild against a different dataset ('uuid://UUID:KEY')

tier.description: Optional — change the depth of the new version

tool_name.description: The analysis to modify (from discover_tools or your library)

tools.name: modify_analysis

tools.description: Check a commissioned build in-chat: stage progress, queue position, rejection reason if the data didn't match the objective, honest ETA, report link when delivered.
tools.name: build_status

tools.description: Ask a question across all your delivered analyses — synthesized answer with citations back to specific reports.

question.description: Plain-language question to answer from your report library

tools.name: ask_library

tools.description: Your report library — every analysis delivered, with status and links. Pass semantic_query to search report content in plain language.

semantic_query.description: Natural-language search over your reports' content

tools.name: reports_list

tools.description: Query your org's data warehouse free: browse the catalog (tables with column roles + computed metrics), semantically find data, plain-language ask, or named templates. Requires warehouse enablement (business plans).
tools.name: warehouse

tools.description: Standing re-runs of analyses you own: action='create' (weekly/monthly against a re-runnable data reference — connector:// or an https:// link; report emailed after each run), 'list', or 'cancel'.
tools.name: schedules

tools.description: Get a shareable browser link for a report — viewable without authentication.
tools.name: reports_view

tools.description: Browse a delivered report's individual cards (charts, tables, insights) inline in chat.

processing_id.description: The report's processing id, returned by run_analysis or build_status

tools.name: report_cards
